body_lead: Maharashtra to establish country's first Artificial Intelligence university The university will promote research and development in AI and related fields and will be a centre of excellence, state IT Minister Ashish Shelar said. Maharashtra is set to establish the first Artificial Intelligence (AI) university in the country and a task force has been formed for the planning and implementation of the project, state Information Technology Minister Ashish Shelar has said.
